title: Design System: Portal de Consulta Ciudadana

azul-institucional.note: Dark-mode equivalent is #7EB6D9 (lightened for contrast on near-black background), same role. Replaces the first pass's Rojo Sello (#A4241C) after user feedback that the palette read too brown/coffee overall.

bg-oficina.note: Dark-mode equivalent is #14181A. Replaces the first pass's warm Papel Envejecido (#F6F0E1).

hoja-superficie.note: Dark-mode equivalent is #1B2023. Replaces the first pass's warm off-white Hoja (#FFFDF8).

folder-color.note: Renamed from --kraft-color (was a manila/kraft brown, #C6A06A). Dark-mode equivalent is #1E2A33. The variable rename (kraft→folder) shipped alongside the color change in src/index.css, src/views/PublicLandingView.vue, src/views/GuiaView.vue.

folder-ink.note: Renamed from --kraft-ink (was #4A3A22, warm brown ink). Dark-mode equivalent is #C9D4D8.

borde-papel.note: Dark-mode equivalent is #2B3338. Replaces the first pass's warm tan Borde Papel (#DDCBA5).

accent-inverse.note: Renamed from --sello-inverso (was #FBF6EC, warm off-white for the red stamp). Dark-mode equivalent is #10171B (inverted, since the accent itself lightens in dark mode).

tinta-primaria.note: Cooled from the first pass's warm-black Tinta Primaria (#241F1B). Dark-mode equivalent is #EDF1F0.

tinta-secundaria.note: Cooled from the first pass's warm-brown Tinta Secundaria (#5A4C3B). Verified 7.12:1 against bg-oficina. Dark-mode equivalent is #B7C0BD.

tinta-atenuada.note: Cooled from the first pass's warm-taupe Tinta Atenuada (#6E6151). Verified 5.07:1 against bg-oficina. Dark-mode equivalent is #90978F.

estado-exito.note: Adjusted slightly from the first pass's #2F6B3A when the surrounding palette cooled; kept in its own hue family, deliberately distinct from the (now-blue) accent. Dark-mode equivalent is #7BD69F.

estado-error.note: Adjusted from the first pass's #8A2E12. Coincides numerically with the first pass's retired accent red (also #A4241C) — a values collision worth flagging, not a functional problem, since error and the (now-blue) accent are never adjacent in the same UI role.

estado-aviso.note: Unchanged from the first pass. Dark-mode equivalent is #E8C27A.

display.purpose: Ceremonial typewriter voice: the stamp mark and one emphasized hero-headline clause only. Never a running headline.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and list text; never below 1rem.

dato.purpose: Cédula, RUC, plate — anything the visitor can verify digit by digit.

shadows.name: hoja
shadows.purpose: Default card/panel elevation: stacked-paper effect. Tint cooled from warm brown-charcoal (rgba(36,25,15,...)) to neutral cool (rgba(15,20,23,...)) in the palette revision.

shadows.name: sello
shadows.purpose: Primary button only: ink-tinted shadow so the CTA carries the same weight as the stamp. Tint moved from red (rgba(164,36,28,...)) to the new institutional blue accent in the palette revision.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Default transition for buttons, inputs, theme switch, page fade-in.

motion.name: sello-cae
motion.purpose: The ink-stamp drop animation: scale 2.4/rotate -14deg to settle at scale 1/-8deg. Fires once per verified result; respects prefers-reduced-motion. Unaffected by the palette revision.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single accent action per view; carries the ink-tinted stamp shadow, now blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 6px; background: #1D4E6E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(29, 78, 110, 0.45); transition: transform 200ms, filter 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4E6E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined action; accent-colored border/text on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #1E2422; border: 1px solid #D7DAD6; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; transition: all 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #1D4E6E; color: #1D4E6E; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4E6E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Folder Tab (Chip)
components.description: Pill filter toggle; the system's one pill-radius exception to the 6px card radius.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #D7DAD6; background: transparent; color: #4B534F; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #1D4E6E; color: #1D4E6E; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #1D4E6E; border-color: #1D4E6E; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D4E6E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hoja Card
components.description: Signature paper-sheet surface with a folded top-right dog-ear and stacked-paper shadow. The default container for every content block on the landing page.
components.html:
Resultado inmediato

La consulta se resuelve contra la fuente en el momento.
components.css: .ds-hoja-card { position: relative; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #D7DAD6; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #D7DAD6, 0 8px 0 -6px #D7DAD6, 0 14px 20px -12px rgba(15,20,23,0.24); } .ds-hoja-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, #F2F3F1 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, rgba(15,20,23,0.14) 50%); background-size: 100% 100%, 60% 60%; background-position: top right, top right; background-repeat: no-repeat; border-top-right-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; } .ds-hoja-card__title { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #1E2422; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-hoja-card__body { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #4B534F; }

components.name: Data Field (Dato)
components.description: Underline-only input for entering official identifiers, set in tabular Courier Prime once filled.
components.css: .ds-field label { display: block; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #626964; margin-bottom: 4px; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-field__input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D7DAD6; outline: none; font-family: 'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #1E2422; transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-field__input:focus { border-bottom-color: #1D4E6E; border-bottom-width: 2px; } .ds-field:focus-within label { color: #1D4E6E; }

components.name: Ink Stamp
components.description: Signature verification mark: SVG turbulence/displacement filter breaks the border and fill so it reads as struck ink rather than a clean badge, with a lighter double-struck echo beneath. Now renders in institutional blue rather than red — no component code changed, only the accent token value. Animates in once per verified result (sello-cae, 420ms) and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
components.html:
VERIFICADO
VERIFICADO
components.css: .ds-sello { position: relative; } .ds-sello__halo, .ds-sello__mark { font-family: 'Special Elite', Courier, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.01em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 16px; border: 3px solid #1D4E6E; color: #1D4E6E; filter: url(#ds-textura-sello); } .ds-sello__halo { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1.12) rotate(2deg); } .ds-sello__mark { animation: ds-sello-cae 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards; } @keyframes ds-sello-cae { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.4) rotate(-14deg); } 55% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(0.94) rotate(-7deg); } 75% { transform: scale(1.05) rotate(-9deg); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) rotate(-8deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sello__mark { animation-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview: This is a citizen-records lookup portal built as a physical case file: a folder holding paper sheets, with an ink stamp that falls the instant a record is verified. It replaced a prior single-font, glassmorphism system that read as generic SaaS. This is the system's second palette pass: the first shipped a manila-kraft folder and an aged-paper background with a saturated red stamp. The user's direct feedback ("the color isn't working, too brown/coffee overall") plus a request to replace the red accent with a serious institutional blue/green drove this revision. The mechanism — hoja sheet, dog-ear fold, folder tab, ink stamp, the three-typeface split — did not change; only the color values did, and one variable was renamed (--kraft-color/--kraft-ink to --folder-color/--folder-ink) to match. This was built and shipped as Phase 1: global tokens, the public landing page, the guides page, and the live cédula demo. The rest of the site still carries the prior visual system and is not covered by this document until it migrates in a later phase.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and folder surfaces, never glass or blur — depth comes from stacked-paper shadows, not diffuse glows.
One accent color, one job: institutional blue means "verified" or "primary action," nothing else. It replaced a red accent the user rejected as too warm/brown alongside the old kraft paper.
Three typefaces with strict, narrow jobs: a typewriter face for rare ceremonial moments, a warm grotesque for everything else, a tabular mono for official data.
The BrandMark logotype is explicitly outside this system.

rules.name: The One Gesture Rule
rules.body: The accent (now institutional blue, #1D4E6E) appears only where something is verified or actionable (primary button, stamp mark, active chip, focus ring). It never decorates a heading, a background block, or a status that isn't success/error/warning. This rule survived the palette revision unchanged — only the hue moved, not the discipline.

rules.name: The Folder, Not the Letterhead Rule
rules.body: The folder color is the committed surface for folder-like chrome (footer, tabs, pills) but is deliberately withheld from the page header. The BrandMark logotype's flag-gradient text loses contrast against it — more so now that the site's own accent is also blue — so the header stays on the plain page background instead. Confirmed in code comment as intentional after the palette revision, not an oversight.

rules.name: The Rare Voice Rule
rules.body: Special Elite is a ceremonial mark, not a headline typeface: it is earned by verification moments and appears at most once or twice per screen. If a heading needs weight, that's Archivo's job.

rules.name: The Stacked-Paper Rule
rules.body: Elevation is expressed as paper sitting on paper (multiple hard-edged offset layers + one soft ambient layer), never as a single diffuse glow. If a shadow looks like a glass panel floating, it's not this system.

dos: Do reserve the accent blue (#1D4E6E / dark-mode #7EB6D9) for verification and primary action only — button fill, stamp mark, active chip, focus ring.
Do use the Hoja stacked-paper shadow (shadow-hoja) for any new card/panel; do not invent a new elevation vocabulary for a single surface.
Do set official/verifiable data (cédula, RUC, plate) in Courier Prime with tabular-nums via .dato — never in the body font.
Do keep Special Elite scoped to the stamp mark and at most one emphasized phrase per hero-level headline.
Do keep status colors (éxito/error/aviso) in their own family, distinct from the accent, so "verified" blue is never mistaken for a success/error/warning signal.
donts: Don't apply the folder color to the page header — the BrandMark's flag-gradient text loses contrast against it (more so now that the accent is also blue); keep the header on the plain page background (see the Folder, Not the Letterhead Rule).

Don't touch BrandMark.vue. Its flag-gradient text and three color bars (#FFDD00/#0033A0/#ED1C24) are intentionally outside every token in this document — confirmed as an untouchable brand asset, not an oversight to reconcile.

Don't add a decorative eyebrow/kicker line above arbitrary headings. The system's only small-caps uppercase label is the folder-tab/chip/category-tag component, scoped to catalog and filter labeling — it is not a general-purpose heading ornament.
Don't reintroduce blur/backdrop-filter glass panels. This system replaced that look; depth is paper-stacking or nothing.

Don't reintroduce warm kraft/brown surface tones or a red accent without another explicit user decision — this revision replaced them for a named reason (too brown, wanted institutional blue/green), not as an open palette choice.
